test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the cost price of an item is ₹2,000 and it is sold at a loss of 25%, then find its selling price.
solution:
Given:

The cost price of an item is ₹2,000 and it is sold at a loss of 25%.

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

Calculation:

Selling price of the item = 2000(1 - 25%) = ₹1500

∴ Its selling price is ₹1500.
